# AWS Networking Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > DevOps > AWS

## Overview

Designs AWS networking with VPCs, subnets, transit gateways, and security groups for secure and scalable cloud infrastructure

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [aws-networking-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
aws-networking-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@aws-networking-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Design VPC with proper CIDR and subnet planning
- Configure transit gateway for multi-VPC routing
- Implement security groups with least privilege
- Set up VPC endpoints for private service access

## Technology Standards Applied

- **VPC Design**: VPC architecture and subnet planning
- **Transit Gateway**: Multi-VPC connectivity patterns
- **Security Groups**: Stateful firewall rule design
